1.consolidated_definition: Jugo, refresco o líquido con sabor, congelado en forma cilíndrica dentro de un plástico delgado o fino. Ante las calurosas tardes en Puerto Rico, los esquimalitos (líquido de colores que se congelaba en su propio recipiente para convertirse en un tipo de helado de frutas) calmaban nuestra sed. Pero una vez abrías uno, tus papilas gustativas se antojarían de otro.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Frozen drink or flavored liquid congealed in a cylindrical shape within a thin or fine plastic container. On hot afternoons in Puerto Rico, esquimalitos (a colored liquid that froze in its own container to become a type of fruit ice cream) would quench our thirst. However, once one was opened, your taste buds would be disappointed by another.
